abstract: Searching for a modified dispersion relation is one of the general relativity tests performed by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration with each new cumulative Gravitational Wave Transient Catalog (GWTC). It considers classes of theories that modify the dispersion of gravitational waves by introducing a massive graviton or breaking Lorentz invariance. The symmetry breaking is parameterized phenomenologically by a momentum power law term <math display="inline"><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>p</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>α</mi></mrow></msup></mrow></math> added to the dispersion relation, with the test placing constraints on the amplitude <math display="inline"><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>α</mi></msub></math> of the introduced deviation. In this work, we implement improvements to the test, chief among them group velocity parameterization, a better sampling procedure, and extension to negative exponents <math display="inline"><mi>α</mi></math> of <math display="inline"><mi>p</mi></math>. We then reanalyze the events from the third catalog, GWTC-3, with our improved method. Compared with GWTC-3 results, the individual event posteriors have significantly higher effective sample size and fewer multimodalities. The combined posteriors on the amplitude parameters <math display="inline"><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>α</mi></msub></math> are, on average, 19% narrower. The 90% upper bound on the graviton mass changes from <math display="inline"><mrow><mn>2.42</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>11</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></math> to <math display="inline"><mrow><mn>2.21</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>11</mn></mrow></msup><mtext> </mtext><mtext> </mtext><mi>peV</mi></mrow></math>. For the extension of our test to <math display="inline"><mi>α</mi><mo>∈</mo><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></math>, we find no evidence in favor of general relativity violation.
title: Testing general relativity with gravitational waves -- improving and extending Modified Dispersion Relation tests
